# ThumbNew – AI YouTube Thumbnail Generator

> ThumbNew is a free AI YouTube thumbnail generator. Creators describe a video in one sentence and ThumbNew generates a high click-through-rate (CTR) thumbnail image in seconds, optimized for the YouTube algorithm.

## What it is
- AI image generator specialized for YouTube thumbnails
- Produces ready-to-upload 1280x720 thumbnail images
- Trained on patterns from millions of high-performing YouTube thumbnails

## Key features
- One-prompt thumbnail generation
- ThumbAI 2.1 iterative editing with version history
- Niche-tuned styles: Gaming, Cars, Comedy, Education, Entertainment, Film, How-To, Music
- High-contrast subject isolation for mobile feeds
- CTR-optimized text and layout

## Pricing
- Free starter credits every month
- Paid plans for higher volume
- No credit card required to start

## Best for
- YouTubers wanting higher CTR
- Faceless and Shorts channels
- Creators with no design skills
- Anyone replacing Canva or Photoshop for thumbnails
